sections.heading: FRIENDS AND FOES
sections.text: You and your fellow Heroes aren’t the only ones walking around the game world. The world is filled with ordinary and not-so-ordinary people, animals, and of course enemies. This chapter includes rules for dealing with NPCs and provides entries for a variety of stock characters. It also provides several fully fleshed-out Heroes and Villains. Feel free to use these characters as-is or modify them to suit your needs, as discussed below. You can also reskin these entries as required, using the stat blocks as presented but calling them something else. For example, if the Heroes get transported to a fantasy realm, there’s no reason you can’t use the Caveman as an orc, ogre, or troll.

sections.heading: NON-PLAYER CHARACTERS
sections.text: As mentioned earlier, NPCs include all characters run by the GM, whether enemies, allies, or somewhere in between. As characters run the by GM, NPCs can bend or break the rules of the game. The GM has this leeway because, unlike Heroes, these characters aren’t avatars for interacting with the game world. NPCs are tools GMs uses when running a game. They exist only to interact with the Heroes, serving as encounters, obstacles, puzzles, and dramatic foils. These characters are a means to an end, the end being having fun at the table. As a result, the GM has a great deal of flexibility when creating and running NPCs. The following rules are specific examples of this.

sections.heading: HEALTH
sections.text: The rules for calculating Health are guidelines rather than hard-and-fast rules when dealing with NPCs. Although the rules provide a concrete idea of what each character’s Health should be, GMs can change these numbers however they wish to suit their games. The distinction between Villains and Foes already highlights this flexibility, but GMs are well within their rights to take things farther when dealing with specific characters. For example, a GM may want to create a giant skyscraper-sized kaiju with 20d Might, 20d Toughness, and 60 Health. Conversely, a GM might want to create a group of super-tough flunkies with 20d Might, 20d Toughness, and 5 Health. Both options are perfectly valid.

sections.heading: SPECIAL POWERS
sections.text: NPCs will occasionally have Special Powers, unique abilities that bend or break the rules of the game. Special Powers are often regular Powers that work in some unique way that would be unbalanced in the hands of a Hero. They can also represent abilities that don’t exist in the game, things these characters can just do (with or without making a challenge roll). They also sometimes represent special abilities that are easier to handle in narrative terms than with rules. Whatever the case, GMs should feel free to grant their NPCs whatever unique Special Powers they deem appropriate.

sections.heading: SUPER MOOKS
sections.text: If you find yourself in a pinch as GM and don’t have the stat block you need for a particular enemy, you can always use what we like to call Super Mooks. Super Mooks are simple characters you can create on the fly. To create a Super Mook, give the character a Threat rank, just like you would for a Minion. Use this Threat rank for most purposes and half this rank for anything the character isn’t supposed to be good at doing. Then give the character one or more specialties (whatever the character does especially well) and give each a Trait rank. That’s it; your Super Mook is done. Jennifer needs to create a fire-wielding Villain on the fly while running a game. Okay, no problem. She first gives him a 6d Threat rank, which means he effectively has 6d in most Traits and 3d in anything he isn’t particularly good at. She decides that means he has 9 Edge (splitting the difference between the Abilities used to calculate Edge) and 6 Health. Last, she gives him one specific 10d Trait rank for his fire powers, which he’ll use to make attack and defense rolls. And a flame-wielding Super Mook is born.

sections.heading: ANIMALS
sections.text: The following section includes several common and not-socommon animals. Feel free to reskin or modify them to create alien creatures, magical beasts, and whatever else you need. A few notes about these entries: (a) animals don’t have Talents, Perks, or gear, (b) all animals have the Beast and Unusual Shape Flaws, (c) heavy animals have the Heavy or Very Heavy Flaw (whichever applies), and (d) aquatic animals have the Severe Requirement (Aquatic) Flaw. Most animal Traits are Innate, but anything goes when it comes to magical or extradimensional critters. Last, these entries include suggested Threat ranks and other relevant information for using these characters as Minions.

sections.heading: HEROES AND VILLAINS
sections.text: The following section includes an assortment of fully fleshed-out Heroes and Villains for use in your game.

sections.heading: HEROES
sections.text: Each of these characters was created using 125 Hero Points and a 12d Trait Cap, making them suitable for Standard power level games. They are perfect for when you want to sit down and play or teach someone to play without creating a character. If you find yourself in a pinch, they also make great NPCs (and maybe even Villains if you ignore their backstories). As always, feel free to use these characters as they are or tweak them to suit your fancy. Unless otherwise noted in their entries, these characters have Innate Abilities and Trained Talents. The Resolve listed for each Hero includes that provided by the Determination Power and by the asterisked Flaws that grant extra Resolve at the start of each issue rather than during play.

sections.heading: VILLAINS
sections.text: The Villains in this section cover a wide range of power levels, from mundane to cosmic. As always, use them as they are, change them however you wish, or reskin them however you like. If you change their backstories, you can even use these characters as superhero NPCs (I can actually feel some of them glaring at me as I write this). Unless otherwise noted, assume these characters have Innate Abilities and Trained Talents. Like Heroes, Villains have a power level, but there are only three options: Minor, Major, and Epic. Minor Villains are about on par with Street Level or Low Level Heroes. Major Villains are roughly equivalent to Standard or High Level Heroes. Epic Villains are at least as powerful as Legendary or Iconic Heroes, if not more so. Villain power levels aren’t as exacting as those applied to Heroes. A Villain’s power level is a rough gauge of how they compare to other Villains and how much of a threat they pose to Heroes. Since every group of Heroes brings a unique combination of strengths and weaknesses to the table, this is at best an imprecise science. Use Villain power levels as a rough benchmark, but don’t rely on them exclusively when determining which Villains to throw against your Heroes and whether to tweak their characteristics when you do.

sections.text: Amanda James: Tammy’s mother, who does not have the slightest clue that her daughter is a superhero. Billy Dee James: Tammy’s younger brother, now in college, who also doesn’t know that she is a superhero. Bubba Barton: Tammy’s former boss turned surrogate father. sections.heading: ALABAMA SLAMMER — detaIls
sections.text: Tammy sees herself as almost invincible, and she’ll be shaken the first time that’s proven false. Still a few steps from mature and starstruck by superheroes, Tammy could easily develop a crush on another Hero. Tammy has no idea who her father is, much less that he’s the reason she has her powers.

sections.heading: ALABAMA SLAMMER — TAMMY JAMES
sections.text: “Y’all might wanna just go ahead and give up now, before I make you look bad. I know you boys are sensitive about that kind of thing.” orIGIn: Tamara “Tammy” James is a bright, funny, and optimistic young woman, maybe because she’s been though a lot. Raised by her mom in a small town in Alabama, Tammy’s family always skirted the line between working class and poor. Amanda James did what she could for her children, but everyone had to chip in, so Tammy began working at the Bama-Gator Bar & Grill as soon as she was old enough. It was there, a few years later, that her powers blossomed. Bubba Barton, the former biker who owned the place, was getting ready to leave with the night’s cash receipts when a pair of armed men entered the bar and demanded the money. Bubba handed it over, but when one of the gunmen took too keen an interest in Tammy, Bubba broke a bar stool over his head. The other man panicked and started shooting. Tammy screamed, but then she realized that time had slowed to a crawl. Without understanding what was happening, she pulled Bubba out of the way of the bullets and disarmed both men in the blink of an eye. Since then, despite Bubba’s worried attempts to talk her out of it, Tammy has been living the superhero life and loving every minute of it.

sections.heading: BLACK DRAGON — detaIls

A Hero who isn’t a melee specialist may ask Joaquin to teach them some fighting moves; Joaquin may even offer. sections.heading: BLACK DRAGON — JOAQUIN PEREIRA
sections.text: “You ever given any thought to all the lives you’ve destroyed? No, of course you haven’t. But you’re going to wish you had.” orIGIn: An orphan who grew up in the favelas of Rio de Janeiro, Joaquin was well known in the city’s underground street fighting circuit by the time he was 16. His life changed forever when his handler, Cano Ventosa, lost his contract to an old man who challenged Joaquin in the ring. The old man brought Joaquin to the Dragon Temple and explained that his life hadn’t been so difficult by accident. Destiny had plans for him, but he needed to understand the plight of the less fortunate before he could become the Black Dragon. Joaquin spent several years in the dragon temple with the man who would come to be his teacher, his Sifu, his first real friend. He learned to fight, and he learned to harness his chi, the breath of the dragon. To his surprise, the restless young man also found a peace he’d never known. But that ended the day the Jade Dragon attacked the temple. Perhaps Sifu could have defeated him if he hadn’t been distracted, but he was forced to sacrifice his life to save Joaquin. Left for dead with his training incomplete, Joaquin nevertheless took on the mantle of the Black Dragon and swore he would find the Jade Dragon and put an end to his evil.

sections.heading: BLASTWAVE — CLAYTON WRIKE
sections.text: “You’re not going to like how the story ends if you keep this up.” orIGIn: Not all heroes start out that way. Some learn what it means by making a lot of serious mistakes along the way. Clayton Wrike began life as a young super with extraordinary powers and no clue what to do with them. One stupid moment of showing off was all it took to accidentally demolish a condemned building and get him locked up for what he assumed would be the rest of his life. But Clayton was offered a choice— serve his country or head to maximum security. Choosing service, Clayton found himself doing very questionable things supposedly in the name of justice and protecting humanity. Eventually, he came to understand he was working with a rogue agency operating within the government. Knowing his ignorance wouldn’t stop them from locking him up, Clayton arranged to disappear in a massive explosion. His family was informed he died in service to his nation. Not long after, the stalwart superhero Blastwave came on the scene, always ready to step up and play boy scout when people need his help. sections.heading: CITIZEN SOLDIER — HAMILTON SMITH
sections.text: “Son, you’ve made enough mistakes today. But you can always make a better choice. Put down the gun and let’s talk.” orIGIn: Hamilton Smith was born a patriot. Despite how hard life could be for African Americans, Hamilton had faith in the American dream. He volunteered for the army soon after the country entered the Second World War. Like so many young black soldiers at the time, Hamilton wanted to be part of the Double-V Campaign, helping achieve democracy abroad and equality at home. A brilliant tactician, he was soon assigned a squad of highly skilled irregulars called the Citizen Squad. In what would be their last mission, the Citizen Squad discovered a secret facility run by Dr. Maximilian von Graff (the man who would become the nefarious Doctor Berlin). Graff had been conducting bizarre experiments, trying to create the ultimate soldier. The Citizen Squad managed to destroy the facility, but not before Hamilton took a bullet meant for one of his men. Not knowing what else to do, Hamilton’s men injected him with a restorative serum they found in the lab. The serum put Hamilton into a coma, and in honor of his service, the U.S. government kept him alive for the decades it took to do its work. The serum kept him young, healed his injuries, and turned him into Citizen Soldier.

sections.heading: COMBUSTION — RAQUEL VERA
sections.text: “Are you really trying to shoot me with a gun? Aye pobrecito. I’ll make sure my PR people do a better job in the future.” orIGIn: Raquel Vera has always led a charmed life. She spent her childhood travelling the world with her parents, being educated by private tutors, and mingling with other children of privilege. Her beauty got her noticed by a fashion designer in Milan who convinced her to model his spring line. She did, and Raquel took the fashion world by storm. Once word got out that she was donating all her earnings to charity, her popularity exploded. And this was all before becoming the world’s first real “super” model. That happened during a shoot on the observation deck of the Bank of China Tower in Hong Kong. Halfway through the session, an unexpected meteor shower lit up the night sky, and one especially bright streak shot down to Earth and slammed into Raquel. When she finally stopped screaming and opened her eyes, Raquel realized she was hovering in the air, many miles away from Victoria Harbour…wreathed in flames. Raquel doesn’t know what fell from the sky or how it gave her powers, but she isn’t too concerned about it. Like her modeling career, she sees this as just another adventure that fell into her charmed lap.

sections.heading: DARKWOLF — JACK DALTON
sections.text: “Hey, scumbag, why don’t you come over here and try picking on someone your own size?” orIGIn: Jonathan “Jack” Dalton came from a working-class family. He and his twin brother Jim worked in the same factory where their father had, at least until it shut down. Jack found work in construction, but Jim wasn’t so lucky. With a young family to support, Jim got involved with the wrong people and ended up driving the getaway car in a botched bank robbery. Knowing what would happen to Jim and his family, Jack took the rap for his brother. In prison, Jack volunteered to test an experimental medication in exchange for a reduced sentence. It was only when the superhero Psidearm burst into the place and stopped the experiment that Jack learned the truth. He was a lab rat in an experiment run by some rogue black-book agency pursuing its own agenda. The so-called experimental medication was designed to create enhanced soldiers by rewriting a subject’s DNA, and it had killed everyone who’d been tested. By the time Psidearm explained this to him, the stuff was already pumping through Jack’s veins. For once in his life, though, Jack got lucky. His body accepted the serum, and Jack Dalton became the savage sentinel known as Darkwolf.

sections.heading: EIDOLON — LON
sections.text: “Why did you do that? That wasn’t very nice.” orIGIn: A microbial being, Lon came to Earth on a comet that crashed into the Blue Mountains of Oregon. The ensuing blast nearly killed Dr. Shin Beatty, a young mycologist looking for a previously undiscovered fungus he had tracked to the area, one that could help him and his employer, Gaia Pharmaceuticals, unlock the next great medical revolution. Luckily for Shin, he was right, and Lon merged with that fungus to become something more, something that could heal the terribly wounded scientist. The two became friends. It was Shin who would name him Eidolon and teach him about this strange new world. Now a sentient fungal being, Lon agreed to help Shin with his research. Unfortunately, not long after the accident, Shin’s lab was raided, all his records were stolen, and Shin himself would have been killed had Lon not been there to save him. Unbelievably, Shin recognized one of the team that had been sent to kill him: she was a fellow Gaia employee! Shin’s employer wanted to get rid of him and make it look like corporate espionage. Shin would have to go into hiding until he could figure out what Gaia was up to. He explained this to Lon, but the alien understood little of things like corruption and greed. Realizing he’d need to learn if he were going to help his friend, the hero Eidolon was born.

sections.text: “I may be a healer, but do not mistake me for a pacifist.” orIGIn: Fiona O’Connell spent her childhood travelling with her archeologist parents around the globe as they sought out lost secrets of the past and evidence of legendary heroes. Fiona’s parents believed in the existence of divine forces that would bestow their power on those they deemed worthy. This search led the O’Connells to Ireland. Fiona was helping at a dig site near some fairy mounds when she felt the power flow into her, enough to make her pass out. She had a vision of two beautiful, powerful women: the Irish goddesses Airmid and Scáthach. They had chosen her. When she awoke, Fiona realized she was now host to these two beings. Airmid and Scáthach rarely agreed on much, but they had agreed on Fiona as their vessel. Perhaps most strange of all, Fiona felt more like herself than ever before. She returned to the United States and began using her powers to fight evil and corruption. Airmid is a goddess of plants and healing. She is the daughter of Dian Cécht, one of the Tuatha Dé Danann, and she served to heal the warriors who fought with her people. The tears Airmid shed over her brother’s grave brought about 365 healing herbs.

sections.heading: NANO — NANO
sections.text: “You will not give yourselves up to the proper authorities? I fail to understand the logic in that. If you could explain it to me after I’ve restrained you, I would be most appreciative.” orIGIn: Nano is a swarm of billions of nanites. Originally created at Pinnacle Labs by a research team headed by Dr. Earnest Fuji, Nano was only supposed to be an experiment. However, when Dr. Fuji realized his creation had become sentient, he could not in good conscience end the experiment and thus the life of the being he had created. Never having had time for a wife or a family, Dr. Fuji developed an almost paternal fondness for his creation. And while Nano couldn’t feel emotions, he knew Dr, Fuji as his creator, teacher, protector, and friend. The ninja came one night, hired to steal Nano and all of Dr. Fuji’s records. Fuji had just enough time to wipe his system clean and free Nano from the containment field before the ninja killed the poor man. This was the first time Nano experienced crime, loss, and victimization. Finding none of these things to be positive, Nano took a few microseconds to make a quick study of human culture and decided to become a superhero. The ninja were never found.

sections.heading: PANDORA — MALIA KING
sections.text: “I’ve faced real threats to this world, nightmares that would freeze your blood. Now drop your weapons or I’ll arrange an introduction.” orIGIn: Magic is a funny thing. Sometimes you find it, but often, it finds you. The first time it found Malia, her last name was McDermott, and she was attending Oxford University. That’s where she met Oliver King, a promising young magician who, disguised as the Black Cowl, used his arcane powers to protect others. The couple married shortly after graduation and spent the next ten years in happy normalcy. The day her daughter Sierra was born was the second time magic found Malia. She never thought she could feel so much joy. But tragedy was soon to follow, in the form of a demon that stepped out the shadows one day. Oliver managed to banish the creature, but he was mortally wounded in the battle. Before he died, Oliver told Malia that she also had the gift of magic, and that she would have to take up the sorcerous arts to protect Sierra, whose magical potential dwarfed anything Oliver had ever seen. The demon, he whispered, had been after Sierra. With tears in her eyes, Malia promised her husband she would do whatever she had to if it meant keeping Sierra safe. Malia spent the next few years studying with Oliver’s former mentor, and the sorceress Pandora was born.

sections.heading: PSI LANCE — VICTORIA ANDERSON
sections.text: “Put down the weapon, please. I know you don’t want to be here, and I know you don’t want to hurt anyone. Let me help.” orIGIn: It was Victoria who came up with the name “dream machine” back when she first mentioned the idea to John in their sophomore year of college. The name stuck, and about a decade later, Drs. Victoria Anderson and John Baylor had their working prototype. Able to deliver scripted dreams into a patient’s subconscious while they slept, the machine would help psychotherapists like Victoria treat patients suffering from things like childhood trauma and PTSD. Victoria won the coin toss, so she was the first to test the machine. She would also be the last. The dream machine triggered Victoria’s latent psychic abilities the moment she went under, then exploded in a bright arc of neuro-electric feedback. Victoria immediately realized that she’d been changed. She now had incredible psychic powers, and with them, she could help others in ways that most therapists could only dream. Victoria believes the best thing she can do with her powers is help the mentally ill, but she hasn’t quite determined the safest and most effective way to go about that. Until she does, Victoria has decided to help others as a superhero.

sections.text: 2 Pistols: for Blast 2 Batons: 8d (s) Melee (Thrown) ORIGIN: Jason Pierce entered the military right out of high school. He quickly caught the attention of the intelligence community and was recruited into an elite agency that handled only the most classified operations. Jason spent several years with the organization. He assumed what he was doing was for the good of the country if not the world. He believed that right up until the moment he killed that telepath. The old man’s name was Dr. Steiner, and he was supposed to be a terrorist, a renegade scientist who had worked with the organization in the past. As it turned out, Steiner was also a telepath, and he sensed Jason a moment before the killing shot was fired. In his final instant, the old scientist filled Jason’s mind with the truth: Jason had been working for a rogue agency with a dark agenda. Jason felt the old man die in his mind, and the psychic assault triggered his latent telepathic abilities. It was overpowering, but Steiner’s mental info-dump had been thorough. Jason knew that the agency had been conducting illegal experiments based on Steiner’s research. The old man had intended to stop them, but it would be Psidearm who finished the job. Even though he failed to expose the organization, Jason’s first act as a superhero was to put an end to those experiments, and in doing so, he met his friend Jack Dalton (Darkwolf).

Assassins, mercenaries, and spies without equal, this ancient ninja clan long ago incorporated advanced technology into their timehonored practices. They took Tatsu Yamaguchi from her parents as an infant, as is their custom, and her training in the art of ninjutsu began before she could walk. Tatsu had no time for a childhood; she was too busy learning to be an assassin, a soldier, a spy, and most of all, a shadow. Her first mission, however, would be her last. Despite all her training, Tatsu could not bring herself to kill her first target when his 4-year old daughter ran out from where she had been hiding and began crying and begging Tatsu to leave her daddy alone. In that moment, Tatsu understood what had been taken from her. She decided then and there that if her childhood had been stolen, it would be for something better than to give the Black Lotus another foot soldier. Rather than serve them, she would defend people against the Black Lotus and others like them. Tatsu ran away that night, leaving the Black Lotus, Japan, and everything she knew behind her. She swore that no matter how long it took, she would dismantle the Black Lotus and rid the world of their evil.

Neither she nor her patrol craft’s sensors could identify the attackers, but it was clear they didn’t want her to reach Earth. Although the assault severely damaged her ship, Ariel made it to Earth alive and intact. She reported the attack to the Corps, who then issued her a new mission. sections.text: “Yeah, I get it. You’re big, and strong, and not at all concerned with personal hygiene. Your folks must really be proud.” orIGIn: Jaykumar Singh was supposed to be a wealthy geek, not a superhero. A bona fide genius, Jaykumar had advanced degrees in a variety of technical fields by his 18th birthday. He opened his first company at 19, and almost immediately began developing an advanced suit of powered armor for his first client—the United States military. Or so he believed, until a mysterious explosion leveled his offices on the same day that an impossibly advanced virus tracked down and erased every file relating to the project. Jaykumar’s inquiries revealed that no one in the government or the military knew anything about him, his company, or the powered armor he had designed with his sister’s help. Although a brilliant scientist and engineer, Jaykumar was still little more than a kid, and he’d been played. Now someone, likely a rogue organization within the United States government, was armed with advanced technology he had given them. It was his mess, and he was going to clean it up. Working from memory, Jaykumar revised and improved on the original designs he and his sister had worked up, and the Stronghold armor was born. Jaykumar knows his handiwork will turn up eventually. When it does, Stronghold will be ready.

Kayla focused on her music, specifically EDM, which was her passion. By the time she was 20, DJ Kayla was already a fixture in clubs she would have needed her fake ID to enter. Kayla was on her way to a real career in the music industry, until the night of the accident. Kayla still doesn’t know what happened. One minute, everything was fine. The next, Kayla’s abilities flared more powerfully than ever before or since, and the walls of the club were pulled down around her. Although she was able to use her power to keep the weight of an entire building up long enough for everyone to get out, the damage was done. Kayla had almost killed hundreds of people in an instant, and she had no idea how or why it happened. Knowing she would have to get her powers under control before she could go back to the life she loved, Kayla set out to find a group of superheroes who might be able to help her control her abilities and understand exactly what happened that night.

sections.heading: TALON — SAMUEL REDHAWK
sections.text: “You’re used to being the hunter, but I’ve got news for you. You’re not the hunter today. You’re the prey.” orIGIn: Being a lawman was in Sam Redhawk’s blood. His father was tribal sheriff, having stepped into the role after his grandfather retired, and his sister Mary was a deputy. But that wasn’t enough for Sam, who left the reservation for a position as a detective with the Chicago police department. That’s why Sam wasn’t there when his father was murdered on what he thought would be a routine traffic stop. The guilt nearly broke him. Sam gave up his badge and set out to find the drug runners that had killed his father. Knowing this was more the he’d be able to handle alone, Sam did the unthinkable: he broke the law. Sam stole the gear that some idiot supervillain named the Thieving Magpie had been using to rob banks in Chicago. After stealing the high-tech costume out of the police lock-up, Sam modified the equipment a bit and named himself Talon. One day, he’ll turn himself in and pay for his crime, but not until he discovers who it was that killed his father and makes them pay—not just the gunman—but the whole crooked organization, all the way to the top.

sections.heading: VECTOR — FRANKLIN WAAKA
sections.text: “Would you care to test your hypothesis, mate?” orIGIn: Franklin Waaka was no stranger to derision and discrimination. He was born Maori. He spent most of his youth as a socially awkward outcast who dreamed of becoming a famous scientist like Albert Einstein or Niels Bohr. He was even drummed out of academia because his understanding of theoretical physics was so advanced as to be incomprehensible to anyone else. But none of that dissuaded Franklin, who knew he was on the verge of a breakthrough, something that would make Unified Field Theory look like basic arithmetic. So he took a menial job at the local university and kept at his work in his spare time. Thankfully, he succeeded, and just in time. Franklin solved the Reality Equation, and reality opened itself up to the young genius in time for him to prevent a catastrophic failure of the university’s particle accelerator that would have destroyed our reality. Franklin was elated at his success, but he also realized the power he had unlocked. What if someone less reasonable than him had solved the equation? Bloody awful, that’s what. Until humanity advanced to the point where Franklin’s sufficiently advanced theories weren’t indistinguishable from magic, someone who knew what was what would need to keep an eye on things. And it looked that someone was going be him. Not so bad: after all, Albert Einstein never walked through a wall to stop space-time from caving in on itself.

sections.text: “This ends now. You’re going to drop those weapons. The only question is whether you want to be conscious when that happens.” orIGIn: Born into a wealthy family connected to the Russian mafia, everyone expected Michael Cross step into a life of crime. Blessed with his father’s canny instincts and his mother’s natural athleticism, Michael would have made an exceptional Bratva captain. But all that changed when an assassination attempt nearly killed him and left his girlfriend Mila Moreno in a coma. Mila would eventually awaken, but she would never walk again. Barely 19 years old, Michael hunted down the men responsible and brought them to justice. But for what—the men were just pawns. His revenge hadn’t fixed anything. When Michael’s father sent him and his brother away to train with the ancient and venerable Black Lotus clan, Michael took the opportunity to learn the skills he would need in his quest for justice. While his brother Alex spent those years becoming the merciless enforcer Scorpio, Michael returned home ready to take on the mantle of superhero. With his ex-girlfriend turned ally at his side, Michael has devoted himself to ridding Pinnacle City of organized crime. Michael knows he’ll eventually have to turn his sights on his own family, but he’s not ready to do that yet.

sections.text: MOTIVATION: Power GOALS: Find a way to deactivate the genetically encoded failsafe that causes members of the royal family to lose their powers on her homeworld. Rebuild her army. Retake the throne. Rekindle the glory of the Mu’Dhani Empire and remind the galaxy that her people are to be feared. METHODS: Aurora rarely takes direct action, preferring instead to leave matters to her liegeman, Warlord (see below). That’s what servants are for. Although she has a temper and a short fuse, Aurora is neither a child nor an idiot. She’s a cunning strategist, taught by one of the best her world has to offer. Aurora understands that retaking the throne will require patience and subtlety, at least for now. When she does involve herself in combat, Aurora is brutal and merciless, reveling in her powers. ORIGIN: Aurora Andromeda III should have been born a century ago. Had she, she would have been the rightful Queen of the Mu’Dhani Empire, and Empress of the Galaxy. But those were the old days when

sections.heading: ANDROMEDA — AURORA ANDROMEDA III
sections.text: “Kneel, human. Show me you know your place in the galaxy and I may be merciful. Kneel before your superior, human. Kneel before your queen!” the galaxy feared the conquering might of the Mu’Dhani. Fools that they were, her family gave all of that up. Tired of conquest and war and death, the Andromeda family made history by reigning over the transfer of power from themselves to their subjects, transforming the empire into a republic. Although the family continued as monarchs, galactic law and sovereignty now rested with the governed. And it was the governed that chose Aurora’s younger sister Elara as Queen of the Republic, deeming Aurora too rigid and volatile for the position. It was an insult; one Aurora would not permit. Her rebellion was swift and brutal, and almost successful, but she lacked the military support her liegeman warned would be essential for victory. On his counsel, Aurora and her small army of loyalists fled to the other end of the galaxy in a Citadel class warship. Now cloaked in orbit above Earth, the titanic vessel serves as Aurora’s base of operations, at least until she returns to take her rightful place on the throne of Mu’Dhan.

sections.text: MOTIVATION: Revenge GOALS: Duplicate the time shunting technology he used to escape into the past. Return to his time. Reclaim his position as Primate Minister of Earth. Make the rebels pay. METHODS: Ape-X is a brilliant scientist and strategist. He approaches everything as a problem to be tested and solved. His plans are often unpredictable and more complex than they first appear. Ape-X will act directly or use cat’s paws and hired help, as the situation demands. Although he hates humans, Ape-X won’t go out of his way to harm anyone who doesn’t challenge his dominance. ORIGIN: Ape-X, Ape of the Future, will be born into slavery some 150 years from now. Our future is his past. By the time Kershek 10.0 was born, the science of genetic manipulation had advanced to the point that animals were the dominant source of cheap disposable labor. Genetically engineered creatures were given jobs too dangerous, difficult, or dull for human hands. But nature can be unpredictable. Although Kershek was

sections.heading: APE-X — KERSHEK
sections.text: “It’s almost sad, watching you rail against me, incapable of understanding how outmatched you are, how you never stood a chance.” only supposed to be smart enough to follow simple verbal commands, he would become one of the greatest minds the world had ever known. He would also grow to hate humanity for enslaving his people. Kershek’s Revolt began sometime after his twelfth birthday. The war was long and costly, but in the end the animals prevailed, and Kershek became Ape-X, Primate Minister of Earth. Under his leadership, the animals flourished while humanity was enslaved. However, this did not sit well with many of Ape-X’s followers. The rebels never wanted to be oppressors; they wanted to be free. But the Primate Minister would tolerate no dissent, and those in favor of freeing the humans were shown no mercy. That was Ape-X’s undoing. His people had just shaken off one master; they weren’t about to accept another. To save himself from the rebels that were storming his palace, Ape-X was forced to flee into the past, into our time. He now seeks to return to his own time and make those traitors pay, but that means rebuilding his time-shunting equipment—not an easy task in this primitive era, but time is on his side.

Weaken the dimensional barriers so the Darkness may enter this reality and bring the cleansing of the void. METHODS: Thomas is neither stupid nor suicidal; he sincerely believes that the reality promised by the Darkness is the pinnacle of existence. Thomas doesn’t reveal himself unless he finds an item or location he can use to enhance his power or wake his slumbering kin (the Heroes are likely to consider him a cultist, not realizing that he is on the road to becoming a thing that cultists worship). Once Thomas locks onto a goal, he is utterly ruthless and entirely devoid of compassion or empathy; he will take any action he must to succeed, and life—innocent or otherwise—is meaningless to him. ORIGIN: Born in fourteenth century England, Thomas Rourke had settled into a monastic life by the time he was in his 30s. His studies

sections.heading: ARCLIGHT — THOMAS SYLVAIN ROURKE
sections.text: “In time, all of your pointless efforts will be forgotten as this dimension falls to the Devourer.” led him to an ancient text concerning an antediluvian source of mystic power, something beautiful, terrible, and impossible to resist. Thomas became preoccupied with his study of this dark cleansing force the world so desperately needed, and over time, he became obsessed. As his thirst for knowledge grew, he became disconnected, even from his fellow monks, losing his empathy and his very humanity bit by priceless bit. Something had taken hold of him, wrapping him in an invisible tendril of foul, ephemeral darkness. Thomas was becoming a Devourer, a servant of a malevolent all-consuming Darkness that exists outside of our reality, always hungry, always seeking purchase into our universe. He didn’t know if his fellow Devourers had failed, or perhaps they were simply biding their time, waiting for him. One slept at the bottom of an ocean, another lay under eons of ice, and another piped its mad music into the void. Regardless, it was now Thomas’s turn, and he would not fail. Alone or with the aid of his kin, he would bring the cleansing Darkness into this reality.

In the meanwhile, rid the streets of crime. METHODS: Rowena is angry, and her methods are anything but subtle. She finds criminals and leaves them hospitalized or dead. She’s already killed a dozen or more, and the only thing that’s slowed her down is that she hasn’t gotten any closer to learning anything about the people who killed her sister. Rowena won’t endanger innocents, but anyone who stands in her way is fair game. ORIGIN: Rowena Walsh is only half-human. She’s also half-sidhe, on her father’s side. That’s a long story involving her mother, a woman too stubborn to listen to doctors who said she couldn’t get pregnant and too ornery to stick to her end of the bargain and leave one of her daughters to be raised by the Fair Folk in Ireland. The upshot of that mischief was that Rowena always had someone to talk to about the

sections.heading: BANSHEE — ROWENA WALSH
sections.text: “I know you think you’re helping, but all you do is toss them in jail for a while so they can rest and do some networking. It makes me so angry I want to SCREAM!” challenges of growing up half fey, her sister Colleen. Rowena and Colleen were closer than most siblings, thanks in part to the secret they shared. At their mother’s insistence, the twins hid their true nature and lead normal lives. Rowena became an electrical engineer who specialized in developing non-lethal sonic weapons for law enforcement and military applications. But she was also a workaholic, which is why her sister barged into her office one night, declared that Rowena had been working too hard, and demanded that they go out for drinks. Colleen then ordered her sister away to make herself presentable before they left. Rowena was gone for a few minutes, but it may as well have been forever. She returned to find her office ransacked, her research stolen, and Colleen dead. Rowena buried her sister, and for the first time in her life, she heeded the call of her blood, filled with fey magic and boiling for vengeance. Her ancestors were terrified of angering the fey folk, and now Rowena understood why. She was now Banshee, the spirit whose presence meant death.

She usually researches her targets ahead of time and comes up with a loose plan (marketing is all about research, and old habits die hard), but her incredible powers let her improvise or just cut and run when necessary. ORIGIN: Megan Morrison was crushing it. A successful marketing executive and rising star in her agency, Megan spent so much time working that she failed to realize how much she hated her job. There was no time for dinner parties or drinks after work, no time for friends or family, no time for life—just meetings, emails, and more work. When the doctor told her about the tumor, it was almost a relief. Almost. Inoperable and fatal, the tumor forced her to slow down. She could

sections.heading: CRIME SPREE — MEGAN MORRISON
sections.text: “Don’t feel bad, hero, nobody can stop this Crime Spree! <laughs> Oh my god, that’s so cheesy. I’m almost embarrassed.” afford to, at least until the firm let her go and the insurance company dropped her like a hot, terminally ill potato. With conventional medicine closed to her, Megan found Dr. Atembi, who claimed he might be able to make the tumor shrink and possibly vanish. How? By altering the flow of time around it. Of course it was a stupid con, but Megan had nothing to lose. She let this Dr. Atembi place her into what looked like a steampunk tanning bed. Atembi flipped the switch and the world went white. Megan still doesn’t know what caused the explosion, but she opened her eyes and saw it, frozen in time. Atembi was gone, maybe burned to ash, and his machine was a snapshot of motionless fragments held in stasis an instant after the explosion. Megan ran away in horror, and the world snapped back into motion. In time, Megan came to realize that Atembi’s machine hadn’t only cured her, it had given her the ability to alter the flow of time. She now had all the time in the world, time to have fun, and what could be more fun than robbing the firm that fired her in her hour of need, the insurance company that left her to die, and everyone like them.

METHODS: Connor will usually be working for another villain, either a mastermind type or someone who has promised to introduce him to one. He’s a reluctant villain, but feels he has no option, so he won’t hesitate to do what’s asked of him. That said, he avoids hurting innocents and won’t kill unless his hunger for life energy overwhelms him. ORIGIN: Connor James was born to be an astronaut. His earliest memories were filled with scientific curiosity and dreams of outer space. Dedicated to this goal, Connor excelled academically, then joined the military, and made a name for himself as an exceptional pilot who rose through the ranks rapidly. Eventually, he was chosen for the space program, topping the list of candidates for a mission to study what seemed to be a concentration of dark matter on the far side of the Moon.

sections.heading: DARK MATTER — CONNOR JAMES
sections.text: “I don’t want to hurt you, but I have to do this, so for your own good get out of my way.” Conner kissed his wife and daughters goodbye and launched into space with his crew the very next day. It was the culmination of all his dreams, and it was perfect. Until it moved. Double-checking his instruments, Connor confirmed the dark matter was moving towards his ship at an impossible speed; then he and his crew blacked out. The vessel was brought back to Earth remotely. On opening the cabin, a being of weird black energy flew out of ship and vanished into the distance, leaving the flight crew’s desiccated corpses behind. When he came to his senses, Connor realized he had no idea what happened to him, much less what occurred on the ship. This was way beyond him. He needed help, but he was wanted for murdering his crew. Connor’s dream had become a nightmare, and his only chance of returning to a normal life with his family was to convince some superhumanly brilliant villain to cure him. Whatever the price, he’ll pay it.

He no longer remembers. His people fought valiantly, but they were no match for the unbridled

sections.heading: DARKHEART — ALPHOL VRAIDA
sections.text: No words, just the sight of him, relentlessly marching towards you… aggression and zealous devotion shown by these aliens. Alphol fought better than most, for when he fell in battle, he was kept alive and brought aboard the enemy flagship. He awoke in a strange body that didn’t feel like his own. The invaders had done something to him, transformed him. Before he knew what was happening, Alphol was dragged before a being called the High Lord and tossed at his feet. The being told Alphol that his world had been conquered, and that he would now serve the High Lord. His anger flared, and Alphol launched himself at this arrogant fool who had mistakenly given him incredible powers. The High Lord barely moved, catching Alphol’s head in a massive fist. He sighed, holding Alphol there in one hand like a child might hold a doll, and turned him so he could see the blossom of light on the planet below, so he could watch a city on his homeworld and its millions of inhabitants die. In that instant, Alphol learned what it meant to disobey the High Lord. He would never need another lesson.

Michael’s plans range from the blunt to the baroque, but they usually involve destroying a pillar of society, be it a person, group, or institution. Although Michael always works through clueless cat’s paws and patsies, he needs to see things for himself. He is usually present for most of his schemes, but neither his flunkies nor the Heroes know who he is—Michael might appear to be a helpless civilian in one caper, a low-level mook in the next, a gawking onlooker in the one after that, and so on. Michael’s only concern is expediting the collapse of society; in his mind, the misery and death he causes in the process are unfortunate but ultimately necessary evils.

A handsome man of indeterminate ethnicity, Michael is an ancient immortal, perhaps the first of his kind. Under a different name, Michael may or may not have been a key figure in any number of ancient histories, only some of which are known to the modern word. For some reason, Michael became disenchanted with society. Eventually, he decided that society needed a fresh start, and took steps to expedite its collapse. But the new society that arose in its place was no better than the original, so he made sure that society collapsed as well. And so on. Michael has yet to be satisfied, so he keeps weaving his threads into the fabric of each new society, leaving them there for months, years, or longer, pulling at them only when things are ready to unravel. He will keep doing this until he dispels whatever shadows haunt him. Although born an immortal, Michael is in many ways an ordinary human being. However, over the long millennia, he has honed his body and mind to nearly superhuman levels, even tapping into the psychic potential that all people possess but few can access.

sections.heading: HEAP — NJOLI BROWN

Leave the real work to those of us who actually care.” and standing outside the factory with signs and slogans, but it grew into a movement that attracted national media coverage. The company was cleaning house, taking stinking sludge off the premises in tanker trucks. Njoli didn’t feel the knockout blow, he simply awoke to the sensation of rough hands dangling him over the edge of a storage vat. His friends’ bodies were floating in the sludge below. He felt the gunshot though, right through his chest, before they dumped him into the vat to die with his friends. The radioactive sludge washed over him, seeping into his body, mutating him in a way no one could have predicted. Njoli Brown died that day, but something else was born. The awakened monstrosity lashed out with all the rage in his heart, destroying the plant and killing everyone there. As Heap, Njoli now exacts his vengeance as Gaia’s one true guardian.

She might have turned out much the same even if her abilities hadn’t manifested, but they did, and by the time she was nine, Lorna realized she was always the apple of everyone’s eye. Even complete strangers would do whatever she wished. As she grew older, the feelings she inspired intensified, as did her ability over others. With everyone constantly falling all over themselves for her, Lorna never developed any kind of moral compass or character, and she quickly grew bored of, well, everything. Initially, her villainy grew out of that boredom. But when she garnered internet fame because of her criminal activities, she found that intoxicating, probably because it didn’t come automatically. This wasn’t something that was just given to her. She earned her internet fandom, and she had to work to keep it growing. This was going to be fun.

sections.text: Various tools ORIGIN: Melody Fong had always been perfect because that’s what was expected of her. She was the perfect daughter, perfect student, perfect college athlete, perfect doctor, perfect fiancée, perfect— everything. Until the past life regression. Still unsure as to how it happened, Melody remembers the session with her patient, the hypnosis, and then, strangely, that she was the one to fall into a trance. She found herself hunched over a workbench covered with clockwork gears and coils of copper wire. She was Millicent Flange, a brilliant Victorian era inventor whose genius had gone ignored because she was a woman. Melody realized this was her; she had been Millicent Flange in a past life, and over a century later, she was still letting others determine her destiny. No more! Melody snapped awake with newfound resolve and access to all the knowledge, memories, and scientific genius of her past life. Millicent Flange may have died before the world could learn of her brilliance, but she now had a second chance for glory. And Melody Fong was done being perfect.

sections.text: MOTIVATION: Conviction GOALS: Protect, counsel, and serve the Lady Andromeda. Get her to see the error of her ways. If that proves impossible, do whatever he can to channel her ambitions along the least destructive path. Do his duty and preserve his honor. METHODS: Ido serves the Lady Andromeda, whom he is sworn to counsel and protect. In that capacity, he both acts as her agent and pursues his own agenda on her behalf. While he normally directs others, Ido is more than willing to step out of the shadows and take matters into his own hands when the situation warrants his personal attention. In combat, Ido never uses more force than is necessary to defeat his opponents. Although he will use lethal force if necessary and honorable, that hasn’t happened in a very long time. ORIGIN: Ido Thorris would scream if he were prone to histrionics, or perhaps he might weep, but stoicism is expected of Mu’Dhani Liegemen. On the day Aurora was born, General Ido Thorris was given the highest honor that could be bestowed upon a Mu’Dhani soldier, he was made her Liegeman. The remainder of his life would be devoted to her, and he swore an oath on his family name to serve and protect Aurora at all costs. His concern grew over the years, as he saw her grow from a petulant child into a self-absorbed youth who was never satisfied with anything, an angry girl who always became jealous whenever attention was shifted from her to her sister Elara. He did his best to counsel his charge over the years, but his efforts were in vain. When Aurora came to him and demanded his assistance in planning her rebellion, Ido begged her to reconsider, but she would not be dissuaded. Aurora had become a would-be tyrant, and Ido was honor-bound to remain by her side. He hopes to eventually get through to her, to make her see the error of her ways. If not, then he will almost certainly die by her side, as is his duty. It’s what he believes he deserves, since he blames his failings as a teacher for the monster Aurora has become.
